annotation.title_clean: Framework for Artificial Intelligence Diffusion (Interim Final Rule, 15 CFR Parts 732, 734, 740, 742, 744, 748, 750, 762, 772, 774)
annotation.title_en: Framework for Artificial Intelligence Diffusion (Interim Final Rule)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Bureau of Industry and Security, U.S. Department of Commerce
annotation.summary_en: US BIS interim final rule expanding export controls on advanced computing chips and creating a new control (ECCN 4E091) on model weights of closed-weight frontier AI models trained above 10^26 operations, with license exceptions, country compute allocations and Data Center Validated End User programs. Software and hardware compute focus; no embodied AI provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Worldwide license requirement for advanced computing ICs (ECCN 3A090.a, 4A090.a)
New ECCN 4E091 controls model weights of closed models trained with 10^26+ operations; open-weight models exempt
New license exceptions AIA, ACM, LPP for low-risk destinations and limited quantities
Data Center VEU split into Universal and National VEUs with quarterly TPP allocations
New foreign direct product rule and red flag guidance for IaaS providers
